summary_pt: Reconstrução parcial com exploração e sistemas locais; sala PvE autoritativa3002 com quatro GEAR, equipamento, habilidades e XP legado. Não equivale ao MMO original completo e não há hospedagem pública.

lan_network.scope: Presence, GEAR poses and plain-text chat only; combat, missions, inventory and rewards stay individual.

persistence.scope: Separate local profile and authoritative SQLite/WAL online pilots
persistence.legacy_local_policy: Read only when no0.9 primary/backup exists; validate before migrating; preserve old file.
persistence.online_store: SQLite/WAL with transactional commands and reward receipts

content.complete_definition: Available native terrain or native non-tile world composition, eligible collision/flags, original props and linked daytime sky/clouds without recorded static-resource gaps; not complete MMO gameplay.
content.mission_availability: Semantic support is not playability: map/actor availability and native level, faction, gear and prerequisite requirements still gate execution.

native_spawn_coverage.definition: Verified ordinary DAT type6 position/orientation and positive native respawn interval; gated special states remain blocked. Supported placements are not complete native monster populations.
native_spawn_coverage.runtime_scope: offline local world; online room encounter positions remain local policy

native_loot_coverage.disabled_definition: Compatible rows with native Probability0; do not roll.
native_loot_coverage.collection: Local automatic collection; native ground-loot ownership/lifetime not ported.

recovered_server_database.policy: Legacy static data is retained with provenance. Current client HP/identity is preserved; runtime verifies compatible fields before combining versions.

implemented.physics: Selected native engine ITEMs, flight/boost/heat/brake/lateral branches, timed landing/takeoff, A-GEAR ground/siege and persisted transition state. Full original state equivalence remains unverified.
implemented.world: Original terrain/flags/scenery and portals, with supported exact native DAT enemy positions and positive respawn intervals. Partial/unavailable art and gated spawn states remain explicit.
implemented.missions: Bounded allowlist compiler for recovered scripts, original requirement gates, kill/dialogue/navigation objectives and idempotent rewards; unsupported clauses fail closed.
implemented.combat: Native ITEM damage/cadence/ammo/heat/range/source formulas, unchanged current-client MEX HP and supported legacy NPC weapons. Bursts and hostile projectiles execute; pursuit/steering remain local bridges. World occlusion applies to weapons and visibility.
implemented.inventory: Owned local items and original icons; validated weapons, engine, armor, CPU, radar and supported accessories with native requirements and selected source modifiers. Catalog browsing does not grant ownership.
implemented.equipment: Source stat increments and caps, explicit bonus-point allocation, native armor/CPU/radar fields and fail-closed unsupported parameters. Equipped armor selects its recovered visual; cosmetic previews remain separate.
implemented.skills: 280 effective ranks supported with class/level/prerequisite gates, eight shortcuts, SP/recasts, defensive modifiers, EP recovery, full resource recovery and timed shield first aid.277 definitions including prototypes remain blocked. Paid learning is local only; online uses owned supported skills and validated assignment.
implemented.economy: 10 source-bound NPC shops,121 memberships and47 cross-version compatible items with native matching prices/bundles and sale percentage. Supported mixing/maintenance remain local. Zero tax and unlimited stock quantity are explicit local policies.
implemented.network: Authoritative WebSocket/WSS PvE room3002 for four classes; server validates flight, combat, equipment, stats, supported skill use/assignment and rewards. Separate ENet LAN presence/chat remains available.
implemented.progression: Native level thresholds to125, recovered legacy monster XP and validated reward receipts. Online XP follows effective damage share with persisted private fractional carry; local combat/mission totals stay distinct. Current2025 full-server progression is unverified.
implemented.appearance: Class-compatible native armor models can be tested visually from M without granting armor or changing combat/engine statistics. Default appearance can be restored.
implemented.audio: Original audio registry and map BGM bindings; music toggle in M. Importing sounds does not mean every original audio event is implemented.
implemented.camera: Local chase camera avoids eligible Collision1 world geometry; other props and original camera behavior are not claimed.
implemented.water: Static original water patches use native map metadata and water/black texture pixels with preserved alpha; complete original DirectX distortion/reflection shader is not ported.
implemented.ui: Original blue HUD/inventory art binds actual resources; searchable local catalogs and native-shop selector; online four-class selection, owned equipment, stats and supported learned-skill actions bind authoritative state. Local services are blocked while online.
implemented.consumables: Self-use effects for71 HP/DP/SP/EP recovery definitions interpreted locally; ownership, native class/level/mode/resource restrictions and persisted shared resource recasts still gate actual use.3 definitions are Infinity-only and blocked in the ordinary local session. Online use is not ported.

native_quest_102.runtime_return_policy: Resolve9999 by faction: influence2->2001,4->2002; local normal profile uses configured start city2001. Fallback to acceptance map is explicit only if required city resources are unavailable.

adaptations: Fixed120Hz clock, keyboard/mouse controls, radius4 contact body, continuous sweep, safe spawning and portal cooldown. Native timed landing/takeoff branches are ported; advanced original flight states remain partial.
Initial level9 local profile and starter reserve are explicit training policy. Online room3002 encounter positions and10SPI per contributing pilot are explicit local rules.

Verified native DAT placements use one actor per placement and positive source respawn seconds. A persisted active-session clock replaces original monotonic OS uptime; exact native channel scheduling/capacity is not claimed.

Compatible legacy XP, ordinary drops and NPC weapons are recovered. Drop rates use solo base rates; collection is local and automatic. Native loot-on-ground lifetimes, rare instances and all special drop paths are not ported.
Initial local training enables compatible rank1 skills separately from native account ownership. Later local learning is paid; online learning has no native school and remains blocked.

NPC position/name/greeting is native when available. Explicit local contact markers/range, zero shop tax and unlimited stock quantities remain adaptations; stock membership is now native and version-checked.
Quick map travel and armor appearance previews are exploration tools; they do not grant items or reproduce original travel restrictions.
Local missile pursuit, NPC movement/terrain response, hit volumes, deterministic RNG, modern lighting/materials and static model poses remain adaptations.
3002 training quest and rings are new local content, separate from recovered missions.
not_implemented: Complete original MMO or official protocol/account interoperability; hosted public service; campaign, economy and multi-map persistence online; PvP, guilds and full formations.
21 unavailable maps and remaining scenery gaps;56 unsupported mission scripts. Supported syntax still requires available maps, actors and native prerequisites.
1243 gated/unsupported DAT spawns and5 regional SMA spawns, native regional clearance algorithm, native war/Infinity/boss state machines and complete channel scheduler/capacity.
Rare/stateful/staged unsupported drops and instance effects; complete native NPC AI, original missile Cinema paths, mesh animations and all visual/audio effects.
277 blocked skill definitions including base prototypes; toggle/charged/group/debuff/special actions, full native overlap rules and every flight/enchant modifier.
Online skill learning and consumable use; complete cash/WP shops, faction taxes, finite stock and stateful instance crafting/enchantment targets beyond the supported local subset.
Complete original DirectX water distortion/reflections, weather/day-night renderer, and proven visual/functional equivalence against the original client.
Native macOS/Windows execution and production VPS validation; load capacity for eight simultaneous pilots.

validation.note: Source suites, real network/migration and both exported desktop packs passed with Godot4.7.2/Linux. Native macOS/Windows execution and public VPS deployment remain untested.
